description: This file implements the MessageException class, which provides exception handling related to message errors, including optional system error messages, within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: MessageException
classes.description: A class representing an exception related to message processing, capable of including system error messages.

methods.name: MessageException::MessageException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and optionally appends the system error message.

methods.name: MessageException::Message
methods.description: Returns the exception message as a C-style string.
